hints.title: Conceptual Cue
hints.content: To solve for x, you must isolate the variable term by undoing operations in reverse order of operations.

hints.title: Strategic Step
hints.content: First add 3 to both sides of the equation to eliminate the negative constant on the left.

hints.title: Concrete Execution
hints.content: 2x - 3 + 3 = 7 + 3 results in 2x = 10. Now divide both sides by 2 to find x = 5.

hints.title: Conceptual Cue
hints.content: Remember that an equation is like a balance beam; whatever you subtract from one side, you must subtract from the other.

hints.title: Strategic Step
hints.content: Undo the addition of 3 by subtracting 3 from both sides of the equation.

hints.title: Conceptual Cue
hints.content: The variable can be on either side of the equals sign; isolate z by removing the constant next to it.

hints.title: Strategic Step
hints.content: Subtract 2 from both sides of the equation to leave z alone on the right.

hints.title: Conceptual Cue
hints.content: Fractions with common denominators can be combined directly by subtracting like fractional terms.

hints.title: Concrete Execution
hints.content: Calculate (17 - 3)/7 = 14/7. Divide 14 by 7 to obtain x = 2.

hints.title: Conceptual Cue
hints.content: When variables appear on both sides, gather all variable terms on one side and constant terms on the other.

hints.title: Strategic Step
hints.content: Subtract the smaller variable term from both sides to keep the variable coefficient positive.

hints.title: Concrete Execution
hints.content: Transpose variable and constant terms to get the form ax = b, then divide by coefficient a.
